system.summary: Blends into the forest: -10 to notice it while fully concentrating, -5 while also using Roots.
system.description: The log troll has the ability to blend in and almost become one with the forest. If a log troll completely concentrates on this ability, anyone seeking it has a modifier of -10. If the log troll activates the Roots ability at the same time, the modifier is lessened to -5.
